Associated Keywords: rightblogger review, ai blogging tools, unlimited ai words, blog automation tools
Friction: RightBlogger prices by site — unlimited AI words on every plan, with the meters on sites connected, SEO reports and active automations instead. The rest of the category meters the words: Byword sells articles, Arvow and Autoblogging.ai sell credits, Outrank and BabyLoveGrowth sell fixed bundles. Roundups compare the headline dollars without noticing the meters point at different things, so single-site high-volume buyers overpay for per-article tools and multi-site low-volume buyers overpay for unlimited words they never use.
Logic: Decide which constraint you actually hit before comparing prices. High volume on one site: RightBlogger's $59 Solo with unlimited words beats any per-article rate — but its automation path is still bounded (30 scheduled posts a month, five per day per site, one active automation), so unlimited generation is not unlimited publishing. Multiple sites at modest volume: per-article and bundle tools price lower than the $89-per-3-sites and $299-per-10 steps. The backlink exchange appears at every tier as a feature label with no mechanism described on the pricing page — evaluate it from the vendor's own docs, separately from the content decision. We are not an alternative: audit-only, no generation.
content_angle: The one tool in the set that meters sites instead of words — the comparison sorts alternatives by which meter the buyer actually maxes out, with every price from the vendor's own page (monthly and yearly toggles both read, verification dated) and the automation caps that make unlimited words less unlimited than the headline suggests. Names our own position: audit-only, not an alternative.
author: Marcus Orion
